horses_adult_cap_within_overall.name: horses_adult_cap_within_overall
horses_adult_cap_within_overall.value:
"horses"."max_daily_minutes_adult" is null
          or "horses"."max_daily_minutes_overall" is null
          or "horses"."max_daily_minutes_adult" <= "horses"."max_daily_minutes_overall"

trainers_tier_2_above_tier_1.name: trainers_tier_2_above_tier_1
trainers_tier_2_above_tier_1.value:
"trainers"."frequency_tier1_min_rides" is null
          or "trainers"."frequency_tier2_min_rides" is null
          or "trainers"."frequency_tier2_min_rides" > "trainers"."frequency_tier1_min_rides"

lesson_types_discounts_non_negative.name: lesson_types_discounts_non_negative
lesson_types_discounts_non_negative.value:
("lesson_types"."frequency_discount1" is null or "lesson_types"."frequency_discount1" >= 0)
          and ("lesson_types"."frequency_discount2" is null or "lesson_types"."frequency_discount2" >= 0)
          and ("lesson_types"."gap_fill_discount" is null or "lesson_types"."gap_fill_discount" >= 0)

lesson_types_group_has_capacity.name: lesson_types_group_has_capacity
lesson_types_group_has_capacity.value:
("lesson_types"."is_group" and "lesson_types"."max_group_size" is not null and "lesson_types"."max_group_size" > 1)
          or (not "lesson_types"."is_group" and "lesson_types"."max_group_size" is null)

students_minor_has_guardian.name: students_minor_has_guardian
students_minor_has_guardian.value:
"students"."age" >= 18
          or ("students"."guardian_name" is not null and "students"."guardian_phone" is not null)
